pages.text: Apotheosis completely replaces vanilla enchanting. The enchanting table still exists but its behavior is determined by the bookshelves surrounding it.$(br2)$(bold)Key difference:$(/bold) All enchanted books have been removed from structure loot. Apotheosis is the enchanting system. You will not find powerful enchants in chests — you will earn them.

$(bold)Bookshelf Tiers$(/bold)$(br2)Different bookshelf types unlock different enchantment pools:$(br2)$(li)Vanilla bookshelves: Basic enchants, lower max level$(li)Apotheosis shelves: Higher max level, wider pool$(li)Dimensional shelves (crafted from dimensional materials): Rare enchants, max-level options$(br2)Building a high-tier enchanting setup is a meaningful investment and a key Tier 2–3 project.

$(bold)Gem Sockets & Enchanting$(/bold)$(br2)Apotheosis affixes add gem sockets to items. Gems and enchants are completely separate systems — they both apply simultaneously. A Legendary sword can have both maximum enchants and 4 perfect gems.$(br2)$(bold)Anvil cap removed:$(/bold) Apotheosis removes the vanilla 'Too Expensive' cap. You can combine and repair items as many times as needed. XP costs increase but never become impossible.
